{"content": "# Promotion evidence: Priya Raman, 1 Jan – 30 Jun 2026

## Summary

Within the window Priya authored about **157 net lines of source**, **90 lines of new tests**, and **40 lines of docs** across 4 shipped features, 1 small fix and 1 doc page. One feature (pagination cache) was written and reverted. One commit cut test coverage, as described in "Problems". The history shows **authorship only**.
